summary: Smith+Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing the timing of its second quarter and first half 2026 results release scheduled for August 4, 2026. The filing provides logistics for the earnings announcement and a subsequent analyst conference call, along with standard corporate background and forward-looking statement disclaimers. This is a routine earnings timing notification with no special-situations content such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It constitutes an ordinary current report on Form 6-K by a foreign private issuer.
